head: fefc4c1 chore(P4-8-A5): audit top solo and vlog fingerprints

root_cause.summary: FocusDecision exists but is not consumed as authoritative visible render policy.

loss_points.name: decision_loss_before_render
loss_points.detail: ReframingCore builds ReframePlan separately and does not receive focus_decisions.

loss_points.name: render_layout_loss
loss_points.detail: FinalRenderDriver render call receives reframe_plan and dynamic_edit_plan, but no focus_decisions argument.

loss_points.name: guard_conversion
loss_points.detail: facecam_intro_guard and facecam_zoom_smoothness_guard can convert facecam_emphasis to balanced_split.

loss_points.name: missing_explicit_layout_branches
loss_points.detail: FinalRenderDriver 32:9 branch only explicitly handles facecam_emphasis; gameplay_crop and balanced_split are not clearly separate visible render modes.

b2_recommendation: Resolve nearest or strongest FocusDecision per TimelineSegment.
Feed resolved policy into FinalRenderDriver or apply it to ReframePlan before render.
Add explicit 32:9 render handling for facecam_focus, gameplay_focus, balanced_split, and drop.
Write render context layout counts and per-segment resolved focus/layout evidence.
Add smoke tests for visible layout policy consumption.
